title: Never Monday Charters (Skagway Fishing)

services.name: Salmon Fishing
services.desc: Fishing out of Skagway is just a short ride to the fishing grounds, usually less than a 15-minute drive. In our area we fish primarily for KING SALMON. The water we fish in is called Taiya Inlet or Upper Lynn Canal. Starting in early May through June we primarily fish for the larger 'breeder' kings. These are the salmon which are ready to spawn and are the worlds largest Salmon - at this point in their lives, some can weigh over 90 pounds! From July through mid October the 'feeder' kings become abundant. These are the salmon that will return in the future to spawn.
